crossRefs.note: “ ‘You shall not lie with any animal to defile yourself with it. No woman may give herself to an animal, to lie down…
“Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.
‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

translations.web: “ ‘If a man lies with an animal, he shall surely be put to death; and you shall kill the animal.
translations.bsb: If a man lies carnally with an animal, he must be put to death. And you are also to kill the animal.
translations.kjv: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
translations.asv: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
